purpose: Make consistent communication achievable for small teams without forcing an agency retainer.

story.origin_narrative: Brand positioning story, not a claim about company founding history. Some businesses have plenty to say and no spare afternoon to say it. The Weekly Signal exists for the week when showing up matters more than producing another elaborate plan.
story.core_belief: Consistency is built one honest week at a time.

signature_phrase: Show up. Say something that matters.

personality.tone: energetic, kind, practical; short rhythmic sentences; no hype
principles: One week is a complete, bounded engagement

design_system.typography: rounded modern sans-serif with decisive bold headlines
design_system.motif: repeating ascending bars and weekly cadence lines

relationship.parent_visibility: Small endorsement after the individual product story; never replace product identity
relationship.payment: Original exact-price Systemia Stripe checkout only; no rebranding of Stripe product without separate approval

governance.visual_identity_direction: Custom CSS motif; not a registered logo or legal mark
